message.content:
Structured blouse in soft peach with hex #deb295, loose cut at the hem falling mid-thigh for ease of breathing while singing, woven cotton-linen blend for breathability.  
Tailored trousers in charcoal grey with hex #36454F, relaxed fit through the leg to allow unrestricted movement during vocal exercises, stretch-woven wool fabric.  
Flat leather loafers in warm taupe with hex #d2b48c, rounded toe design ensuring comfort for walking between lessons or standing long periods, smooth calfskin leather.  

This outfit works because it prioritizes your wish for simple and comfortable footwear while maintaining a polished yet relaxed silhouette perfect for a vocal lesson. The loose blouse and relaxed trousers ensure complete freedom of movement needed for breathing and singing, avoiding any restrictive clothing. The neutral earthy tones complement your natural skin and hair tones without overwhelming the professional autumn setting.
